newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close higher in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close higher in moderate trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks edged up in restrained trading that was dominated by domestic investors, brokers siad.
The all share index closed 1.03 points up at 639.43. Ceylon Cold Stores rose three rupees to 93, and Regnis 2.25 to 22.75.
"Trading was lacklustre due to a shortage of foreign investors and buyers not willing to be dictated to by sellers," said a trader at brokerage John Keells.
Foreingers are probably revaluing Asian equity invesmtents in the light of the recent U.S. rate hike and market perception that there the Federal Reserve may increase rates again, brokers said.
A shortage of sellers, who were holding out because of hefty premiums, also led to dull trading, brokers said.
Turnover was 27.7 million rupees on 909,303 shares, led by 60,000 Bata Shoe Co, 90,000 Ceylon Grain Elevators, 130,000 Seylan Bank.
